Mark one or more todos as completed.

You can pass todo IDs, Basecamp URLs, or comma-separated IDs:
  basecamp todos complete 789
  basecamp todos complete 789 012 345
  basecamp todos complete 789,012,345
  basecamp todos complete https://3.basecamp.com/123/buckets/456/todos/789

USAGE
  basecamp todos complete <id|url>... [flags]

ARGUMENTS
  <id|url>...  ID or URL (one or more)

FLAGS
  -h, --help   help for complete

INHERITED FLAGS
  -a, --account string   Account ID
  -j, --json             Output as JSON
  -m, --md               Output as Markdown (portable)
  -q, --quiet            Output data only, no envelope

LEARN MORE
  basecamp todos --help
